confounds_reason: The hard Betti summaries are constants, so no architectural association is even measurable on them. For the threshold-free family I found a MECHANISM that neither prior review reported and that matters more than any correlation: under the hop metric EVERY H1 bar has lifetime exactly 1. I measured the full H1 barcode on five clouds -- iid Gaussian d=768 N=1000 (3,032 bars), a uniform 3-cube N=1000 (38 bars), and gpt2 layers 0, 5 and 11 (130, 145 and 58 bars) -- and the set of distinct lifetimes is exactly {1.0} in every case. Since the code divides by the component's geodesic diameter, `h1_max_persistence` is therefore identically 1/(hop diameter): measured 1/9, 1/12 and 1/11 against diameters 9, 12 and 11 on those gpt2 layers, and ALL 36 panel layer values across the four models are exactly 1/integer (gpt2 1/9, 1/11, 1/19, 1/19, 1/17, 1/16, 1/15, 1/13, 1/12, 1/11, 1/9, 1/11). So the quantity the manuscript presents as the threshold-free carrier of the H1 signal is a kNN-graph DIAMETER readout, not a persistence measurement; `h1_total_persistence_mean` is (bar count)/diameter. Over the four models it has Spearman +0.894 with vocab size (p = 0.106) and -0.775 with d_model (p = 0.225), but at n = 4 the mechanism is the evidence, not the correlation.
